tool.name: RECAP-PROK CDS Comparison
tool.description: CDS comparison between Liftoff-mapped reference annotation and Prodigal re-annotation

organization.name: Department Computational Biology and Chemistry (COMPBC), Helmholtz Centre for Environmental Research (UFZ)

tool.command: set -euo pipefail && mkdir -p outdir && export RO_TH='$reciprocal_overlap' && export GENOME='galaxy_sample' && bash '$__tool_directory__/module3_table3_columns.sh' '$input_mapped' '$input_prodigal' outdir && test -s outdir/module3_table3_wide.tsv && test -s outdir/pairs_classified.tsv && test -s outdir/FINAL_Re-annotated_CDS/galaxy_sample_FINAL_CDS_ids.tsv && test -s outdir/FINAL_Re-annotated_CDS/galaxy_sample_FINAL_CDS.gff && cp outdir/module3_table3_wide.tsv '$wide_table' && cp outdir/pairs_classified.tsv '$pairs_classified' && cp outdir/FINAL_Re-annotated_CDS/galaxy_sample_FINAL_CDS_ids.tsv '$final_cds_ids' && cp outdir/FINAL_Re-annotated_CDS/galaxy_sample_FINAL_CDS.gff '$final_cds_gff'

param.name: input_mapped
param.label: Liftoff-mapped reference GFF
param.help: Reference CDS annotation already mapped to the target genome coordinates, for example output produced by Liftoff in Galaxy.

param.name: input_prodigal
param.label: Prodigal re-annotation GFF
param.help: Prodigal-based CDS annotation for the same bacterial chromosome or plasmid sequence.

param.name: reciprocal_overlap
param.label: Minimum reciprocal CDS overlap
param.help: Default: 0.80, matching the RECAP-PROK CDS comparison analysis.

tool.help:
RECAP-PROK CDS Comparison compares a Liftoff-mapped reference CDS annotation with a Prodigal-based re-annotation of the same sequence.
INPUTS
1. Liftoff-mapped reference GFF The reference annotation must already have been mapped to the coordinates of the target bacterial chromosome or plasmid.
2. Prodigal re-annotation GFF The CDS annotation generated by Prodigal for the same target sequence.
The input filenames do not need to follow RECAP-PROK genome naming conventions. Galaxy supplies the selected datasets directly to the tool.
ANALYSIS
CDS features from the Liftoff-mapped reference annotation and the Prodigal re-annotation are compared using reciprocal genomic overlap.
The default minimum reciprocal CDS overlap is 0.80, corresponding to the RECAP-PROK CDS comparison analysis.
The same analysis is applicable to bacterial chromosomes and plasmids. Separate bacterial and plasmid implementations are therefore not required.
OUTPUTS
The tool produces four principal outputs:
1. CDS comparison summary 2. Classified CDS pairs 3. Final CDS evidence IDs 4. Final CDS evidence GFF
GALAXY WORKFLOW
Liftoff is intentionally treated as a separate Galaxy tool/workflow step. The Liftoff-mapped reference annotation can be passed directly to this tool together with the corresponding Prodigal annotation.
This design allows RECAP-PROK CDS Comparison to be incorporated into a larger Galaxy workflow without duplicating the Liftoff implementation inside this tool.
